# Feel Your Protocol — MCP Server Docs

> Concrete documentation for the Feel Your Protocol MCP server: deterministic
> future-Ethereum-protocol simulations for AI agents, tool reference, and technical setup.
> Present-tense "what we have" — for humans and AI. Vision and draft concepts live on the roadmap site.

## Guide

- [Overview](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/guide/overview.html): What we are building, repos, status, design principles
- [Roadmap vs MCP Docs](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/guide/roadmap-relationship.html): How this site relates to roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org

## Related (fleet)

- [Main site](https://feelyourprotocol.org/): Interactive Ethereum protocol explorations (Leg A)
- [Roadmap](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/): Vision, strategy, draft Agent API / x402 concepts
- [Website Docs](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/index.html): Contributor guide for the explorations website
- [Community Token](https://community-token.feelyourprotocol.org/): FYP token transparency on Base

## Planned endpoint

- MCP server (HTTP): `https://mcp.feelyourprotocol.org/mcp` — not live yet; documented here as it ships.

## Source

- [GitHub — website repo](https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website): MCP docs content lives in the `mcp-docs/` folder
- Execution engine + gateway: separate repos (`mcp-execution-engine`, `mcp-gateway`) — coming in build steps 2–3

## Notes

- Built with VitePress; static HTML on mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org after deploy.
- Sensitive server configs (nginx details, secrets) live in the private `server-config` repository.
- Not financial advice; not affiliated with the Ethereum Foundation.
